source_text: No federal bans exist, and courts defer to parental rights absent abuse, though advocacy groups like Intactivists argue neonatal procedures constitute non-consensual genital cutting, citing cases such as a 2025 petition against a hospital circumcision performed without explicit parental reaffirmation post-delivery. [73]
